title.narrative: TB Digital Technologies and Artificial Intelligence - Trace TB

description.narrative: (India): ..The Ayushman Bharat Digital Health Mission (ABDM) aims to develop the backbone necessary to support the integrated digital health infrastructure of the country. This mechanism supports the building block of ABDM and builds the country's Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities to enhance the National TB Elimination Program to meet its goals...Using FY 2022 funds, Trace-TB will introduce AI solutions for TB that help strengthen the delivery of healthcare services, accelerate efforts to eliminate TB, and better respond to infectious diseases in India. This will be achieved through the following approaches: 1) create an enabling environment to adopt sustainable digital and AI solutions that address existing and emerging infectious diseases; 2) support research and development for innovative digital and AI solutions across the cascade of care to effectively manage infectious disease threats; and 3) demonstrate early adoption of efficient digital and AI solutions for existing and emerging infectious diseases..These interventions support the U.S. Government's Global Tuberculosis Strategy, which aims to reach every person with TB, cure those in need of treatment, and prevent the spread of disease and new infections. .
